newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepal's king names Chand new prime minister.
newsitem.headline: Nepal's king names Chand new prime minister.

text.p: Nepal's King Birendra on Monday named Lokendra Bahadur Chand the Himalayan kingdom's new prime minister, a statement from the royal palace said.
Palace officials said Chand, leader of the centrist Rashtriya Prajatantra Party (RPP), was expected to be formally sworn in on Tuesday.
Chand has the support of Nepal's former ruling communists, the Unified Marxist-Leninist (UML) party.

Earlier on Monday UML General Secretary Madhav Kumar Nepal and Chand registered a joint claim to govern at the gates of King Birendra's palace. The king had set a deadline of 6.00 p.m. (1215 GMT) for claims to a new government to be staked.

A UML leader told Reuters earlier on Monday that his party and its allies controlled 103 of 205 seats in the lower house of parliament -- just enough to survive -- and would support Chand as the new prime minister.
